messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm prepping a docs PR to add a 'throughput guidance' section to the model catalog and update SDK snippets. Need quick bench numbers and a tiny migration blurb for teams using batching/KV cache. Draft here: https://redwood.internal/docs/drafts/throughput-guidance. Will cover recommended batch sizes, tokens/sec on p4d/p3, and quantized fallbacks. Any perf owners able to paste numbers?

kevin: I can run Mistral7b + Llama3-13b (quantized/unquant) on p4d tonight and paste results. Will measure at seq_len=2k, batch=8.

alex: FYI SDK snippet change — the new client surface uses streaming=True and renamed batch hint param (platform.batch_hint). We'll need both python/js examples updated.

sam: Runtime note: we flipped the dynamic batching cutoff last week (lower threshold for grouping). That might change steady-state tok/s for small sequences — I'll add a note about seq-len assumption in the guidance.

jen: Which page should the migration blurb live on? model card, or a separate migrations guide?

maria: Put a short paragraph on each model card (under 'throughput guidance') + a link to /docs/migrations with a short 'what changed' checklist. Keep migration text <= 3 bullets.

docs-bot: docs-bot: PR opened by maria: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/1234 (WIP)

kevin: Quick bench (p4d, seq=2k, batch=8): Mistral-7b unquant ~900 tok/s, q4_0 ~420 tok/s; 95th latency unquant 18ms, q4_0 28ms. Llama3-13b unquant ~320 tok/s, q4_0 ~150 tok/s; 95th 48ms/82ms. I'll drop CSV + gist.

alex: can you also capture p3 numbers (for estimate)? some customers use p3s.

kevin: added p3: Mistral7b unquant 520 tok/s, q4_0 240 tok/s. Llama3-13b p3 unquant 180 tok/s, q4_0 90 tok/s. All measured with warm cache.

sam: Note for docs: quantized variants skip some fused kernels on current runtime which bumps short-request latency — add a compatibility note "quantized variants may have higher 95th latency for seq<128".

maria: Great — plan: I'll update the model cards with the numbers + a short 'how to pick batch size' table and add migration bullets. Target: merge by EOD Fri. Reviewers: @alex @kevin @sam @jen. Anyone else?

jen: LGTM, I can review wording and clarity.

alex: I'll patch SDK examples after merge and update the SDK changelog (SDK v0.9.0). Also change example param `batch_size` -> `platform.batch_hint`.

kevin: heads-up — I fixed two dead links in the catalog table (perf-dashboard -> bench.viz). PR updated.

maria: quick question — example snippet in PR currently shows: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
c.generate('Hello', model='mistral-7b', batch_size=8)
``` Do we want to switch to new names in the model card examples?

alex: yes, change to: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
c.generate('Hello', model='mistral-7b', platform={"batch_hint":8}, streaming=True)
``` I'll push that patch after docs merge.

sam: I'll run a quick smoke test against staging after merge and ping #eng-oncall if anything regresses.

docs-bot: docs-bot: PR merged by maria (merge commit: abc123) — merge_ts: 1827600000

maria: Closing thread — thanks everyone :rocket:
